Interim devil-advocate review (non-routed in-IDE): Gemini Pro pass in, reconciled vs corpus. H1 ambiguity OVERTURNED (matches no-regression sweep). H2 catch-filter UPHELD Major CONFIRMED (broad catch(Exception) over whole moduleItem swallows genuine builder bugs when an unrelated error node exists; fix=narrow to NRE/shallow). H3 keyword-scope: Gemini Critical -> Opus PARTIAL (constructs fail but were pre-existing, NOT regression - keyword tokens never lexed as identifiers; NONE in HHC corpus; scope-widen decision, not blocker). H4 TypeSuffix->wrong-return-type: Gemini Critical -> Opus PARTIAL (mechanism real: Function SqlStr$() -> ReturnType null -> consumer reads Variant not String; but no suffixed function in HHC corpus so golden safe; matters for corpus case 14 + real DBs). H5 map-suffix->TypeReference UPHELD Major: cleaner design resolving H4 at source, but deviates from spec F-3-3 literal -> question-the-spec, needs human/synthesis call. Net: HHC golden safe to regen; H2 worth fixing; H3/H4/H5 genuine but latent/scope/architecture. GPT 5.4 pending; synthesis+fixes deferred until both in.

GPT 5.4 devil-advocate pass in (ran real AccessHarvester parse probes) + Northwind representativeness benchmark + synthesis. GPT: H1 OVERTURNED (probed ReDim Preserve a(10) vs Preserve(10) - disambiguates). H2 PARTIAL/Minor (broad but no concrete current bug; keep guard, narrow+pin). H3 UPHELD Major SHARPENED - the real change-induced must-fix is the named-argument symmetry hole (Fable added contextualKeywordName to parameter rules so Sub F(step As Long) parses, but namedArgument still IDENTIFIER-only so F Step:=1 fails - internal inconsistency the change created, corpus-independent). H4 UPHELD Major (Function SqlStr$() -> null ReturnType -> projects Void; fix via existing ReturnType channel, not schema). H5 OVERTURNED - contradicts Gemini: KEEP TypeSuffix (established convention, preserves raw spelling), fix the bridge not the representation. Northwind benchmark (66 Microsoft modules, local-only, genericized): 0 suffixed function/property names, 0 suffixed declarations, 0 Line/Circle graphics; only ~7 $-string-function call sites (already parse). So H3/H4 constructs absent from BOTH corpora = latent, not golden-impacting; HHC golden safe to regen. Synthesis: FIX H2(narrow)+H3-namedarg+H1-pins (in-scope); H4 type-emission is spec-deferred (F-3-5-adjacent) latent -> human decision fix-now-vs-defer; H3 other-slots scope decision; H5 adjudicated to GPT (keep TypeSuffix). Ledger updated; awaiting human decision on the two scope calls before resuming build-out.
